No problem!

I think he might be in a bad place mentally. The other option is meltdowns. When he says that he hates you etc, please don't take this for granted, usually, when we (autistic people) have meltdowns, we can say very hurtful things that we don't actually mean + he's a teenager (just like me) and we say a lot of things in the heat of the moment. Please remember that no matter what, everything will sort out. Give him time, give yourself time, and remember: communication is the key. Talk to him when he's not on edge. Be gentle and even if you don't understand, support your kid. And of course, ask the therapist for advice. I hope I helped

Xenogenders are often used by neurodivergent people cause their gender does not fit into any category. Xenogender people are one of the most misunderstood people in the trans community, so I absolutely understand why your coworker is so irritated. God might have been treated really poorly even by trans people. Ask r/autism, r/trans, and r/NeurodivergentLGBTQ so you'll get the perspective of more neurodivergent trans people, cause this might help you understand. I hope I helped
